summary_en: 1,047,600 shares cancelled (5.5% of shares outstanding). Effective 2026-08-25. Post-cancellation issued shares: 17,999,300.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Treasury Share Cancellation
translation_en_brief: MegaChips Corporation announced completion of the cancellation of 1,047,600 treasury shares, effective 2026-08-25. The cancellation was authorized by board resolution on 2026-02-06 under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The shares cancelled represent 5.5% of shares outstanding prior to cancellation. Following completion, the company's total issued shares outstanding (excluding treasury) are 17,999,300.
